findings.title: Mock Leakage
findings.body:
The `vi.spyOn` mocks on the `window.localStorage` getter and on `Storage.prototype.getItem`/`setItem` are never restored. There is no `afterEach(() => vi.restoreAllMocks())` in this file.

The `it.each` cases run in the order `access`, `read`, `write`. After the `access` case, the getter still throws. The next `beforeEach` then calls `window.localStorage.clear()`, which throws and fails the `read` test.

Even if that call did not throw, the `read` and `write` cases would still be exercising the access-failure path instead of the operation they are meant to test.

This depends on the Vitest config: it is only harmless if `restoreMocks: true` is set globally, which is not visible in this diff. Add explicit mock restoration to make the tests order-independent.
